Most of us who've played several hot conditions had the consensus that Sunday's pullback would of been a little more extended due to the froth and cyclical nature of how onchain usually reacts when its been up only for a few weeks straight. Not trying to get ahead of myself as it's only been a 24 hour period, except these are one of the key signs/turning points you look for when analyzing what kind of environment we're in. We're already seeing traders become hungry and dig for new narratives, specifically penny stocks. As tokenized stocks are going down the risk curve with increased appetite, tokens like $CTO are spawning and traders like Rune are acquiring companies which look dead in the water with large amounts of short interests. Fees go directly into buying back the stock and short squeezing the asset. I think this is going to become much more of a frequent phenomena now we've seen so much demand for tokens like AI and their underlying launchpad. The current idea of stocks being the pairing to native tokens is cool but doesn't offer much reflexivity. Finding ways to leverage the volatility of stocks will be where we see the crazy trades moving forward imo. There's an interesting overlap as deep domain knowledge is required in tradfi to pull this off successfully, so it's going to be interesting watching these style of experiments and becoming familiar with the inner workings of them. The stock is already up 8% from CTO's volume alone. It has the chance to flywheel quite aggressive if it does pick up steam. Also think the Sol eco rebounds with the stock meta soon. Lots of RR for those willing to put in the research, even if CTO doesn't succeed I'll be looking for adjacent narratives. High risk, very low liquidity and purely a gamble, narrative is too good not to try though.

text_x: Ontology, Injective Hit by Block Halts; Suspected Injective Exploit Nets $4.9 Million Layer-1 networks Ontology and Injective both suffered block-production halts around Aug. 31 amid security concerns. Ontology, an identity-focused public blockchain, initially paused its mainnet as a precaution and said on Sept. 1 that it had identified malicious activity targeting the network, while confirming user assets were not compromised.
